name: thesis-tracker
description: Track a falsifiable belief over time: its pillars, what would invalidate it, and every piece of evidence tagged as strengthening, weakening, or neutral.

thesis.help: The claim, stated so it could be proven wrong. "AI will change things" cannot be tracked; "cold starts will stay above 3s through Q4" can.

evidence.help: New evidence to weigh. Left empty, this re-reads the existing record and re-states where the thesis stands.

metadata.why_falsifiable: A thesis with no invalidating conditions cannot be tracked — every piece of evidence confirms it, which is how a tracker becomes a scrapbook. The invalidators are asked for up front so the record can actually change your mind.

steering_examples.description: Track the thesis that our cold starts stay above three seconds through Q4, and weigh today's benchmark against it.
That last piece of evidence is weaker than it reads — mark it neutral rather than strengthening.

example_outputs: a falsifiable belief with its pillars, invalidators, and evidence
